subtitle: Often overlooked but crucial to your sound, cables are the lifeline of your signal. Learn how to choose quality cables that preserve your tone and last for years.

introduction.title: Why Cable Quality Matters
introduction.text: Your cables are the foundation of your signal chain. Poor cables can rob you of tone, introduce noise, and cause frustrating failures at the worst possible moments.

columns.title: Signal Integrity
columns.text: Frequency Response: Preserves your guitar's natural tone. Signal Strength: Maintains output level to your amp. Noise Rejection: Shields from electromagnetic interference. Clarity: Prevents signal degradation and loss.

columns.title: Reliability & Performance
columns.text: Durability: Withstands regular use and movement. Connection Quality: Reliable plugs and jacks. Flexibility: Easy to handle and position. Longevity: Years of dependable service.

cards.title: Standard Instrument Cable
cards.description: TS (Tip-Sleeve) unbalanced signal with standard 1/4" jacks. Basic shielding and most common type for guitar to amp connections.

fields.label: Best For
fields.value: Direct guitar to amplifier connection, pedal connections

cards.title: Balanced Cable
cards.description: TRS (Tip-Ring-Sleeve) balanced signal with noise rejection. Longer runs possible with professional grade construction.

fields.label: Best For
fields.value: Studio recording, long cable runs, professional setups

cards.title: Speaker Cable
cards.description: TS Heavy gauge with thick copper wire, high current capacity, low resistance and durable construction.

fields.label: Best For
fields.value: Connecting amplifier heads to speaker cabinets

cards.title: Patch Cable
cards.description: Short TS cables that are flexible with right-angle options and space efficient design for pedalboard use.

fields.label: Best For
fields.value: Connecting effects pedals in pedalboard setups

cards.title: Shielding Types
items: Spiral Shield: Good flexibility, lower coverage
Combination: Foil + braid for best protection

cards.title: Long Cables (25+ ft)
items: Best for: Large stages, wireless backup

cards.title: Monster Cable - Rock Series
cards.description: Heavy marketing, thick construction. Popular with many 80s/90s rock stars.

cards.title: George L's - Custom Cables
cards.description: Low capacitance, custom lengths. Popular with pedal enthusiasts and pros.

cards.title: Mogami - 2524
cards.description: Studio standard with excellent shielding. Used by studio professionals worldwide.

cards.title: Planet Waves - American Stage
cards.description: Lifetime warranty, road-tested. Popular with touring musicians.

cards.title: Proper Storage
items: Separate Storage: Keep power and audio apart
Label Cables: Identify length and purpose

cards.title: Live Performance Tips
items: Cable Routing: Away from foot traffic
Tape Down: Secure at critical points
Quick Check: Test before every show
